items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Danny Barcelona and his wife (Bennie was her name)

ctx.x: No, sir. He said, "When a man is taking a solo, anything you do to distract him... That's his spot, and you don't do nothin' to distract him, because you wouldn't want him to do it on your solo." He says, "I don't do it." And then he says, "You guys just be quiet, that's all." Outside of that, nothing.

And he was a real compassionate guy when it came to... I remember one time in particular, Danny Barcelona and his wife (Bennie was her name), they was having a terrible time, and Danny was drinking and stuff like that, and spending his money... It got so that it affected Danny's playing. And everybody in the band noticed it; Danny was throwing people off and he was playing horrible.
